```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(

```

The default behavior of basecoat is to act as a pure html library. However, you can **opt-in** to [`{shiny}`](TODO!) interactivity.

Note that, if you are using basecoat with the shiny package, you should always use the basecoat components _instead_ of shiny or an alternative library like `{bslib}` (TODO hyperlink). This is because both shiny and bslib use the bootstrap library for styling. basecoat, which is based on tailwind css (TODO hyperlink), has conflicting styles with bootstrap

## Quickstart

Basecoat, by default, does not load its shiny dependencies. Use `bc_shiny_deps()` to load the shiny interactivity.

A minimal sidebar app looks like: 

```{r setup}
library(shiny)
library(basecoat)

ui <- bc_page_sidebar(
  # add shiny deps
  bc_shiny_deps(),
  # give it a title
  title = "{basecoat} tutorial",
  # add a theme toggle
  header = bc_theme_switcher(),
  # populate the sidebar
  sidebar = bc_sidebar(
    id = "sidebar",
    bc_sidebar_group(
      title = "Sidebar section"
    )
  )
)
```


## Updating Inputs

Each of the components provided by basecoat can be updated and modified in the shiny server function. Many of these components can be modfied directly by Shiny:


| Input | Update |
| ----- | ------ |
| `bc_checkbox()` | `shiny::updateCheckboxInput()` |
| `bc_switch()` | `shiny::updateCheckboxInput()` |
| `bc_textarea()` | `shiny::updateTextAreaInput()` |
| `bc_native_select()` | `shiny::updateSelectInput()` |
| `bc_input()` | `shiny::updateTextInput()` |
| `bc_input(type = "password")` | `shiny::updateTextInput()` |
| `bc_input(type = "number")` | `shiny::updateNumericInput()` |
| `bc_select()` | `shiny::updateSelectInput()` or `bc_update_select()` |
| `bc_button()` | `shiny::updateActionButton()` |
| `bc_command()` | `shiny::updateTextInput()` |

Thee following components must use bespoke handlers: 

| Input | Update |
| ----- | ------ |
| `bc_radio_group()` | `bc_update_radio_group()` |
| `bc_slider()` | `bc_update_slider()` |
| `bc_combobox()` | `bc_update_combobox()` |
| `bc_accordion()` | `bc_update_accordion()` |
| `bc_theme_switcher()` | `bc_update_theme_switcher()` |

## Example

Basecoat ships an example shiny app that illustrates how to use every single component. 

```r
shiny::runApp(
  system.file("examples", "shiny-inputs.R", package = "basecoat")
)
```

Run this example application to see each component in use.
